lines.zh: 我沿宝库外墙走第七圈。
lines.en: I walk the seventh circuit of the vault wall.

lines.zh: 石英地面反光，我的影子跟得紧。
lines.en: The quartz floor shines; my shadow keeps close.

lines.zh: 每扇门我都要推一下，确认锁着。
lines.en: I push every door to confirm it is locked.

lines.zh: 钥匙挂在腰上，走路会响。
lines.en: The keys at my belt ring as I walk.

lines.zh: 廊柱之间太窄，我的肩擦着石。
lines.en: The pillars are narrow; my shoulder scrapes stone.

lines.zh: 换岗的时间到了，我去西门。
lines.en: Shift change is due; I head for the west door.

lines.zh: 我把火把插回原位，没有人动过。
lines.en: I set the torch back; no one has touched it.

lines.zh: 巡逻路线不许改，我记住了。
lines.en: The patrol route may not change; I know it by heart.

lines.zh: 靴底磨平了，走路没声。
lines.en: My soles are worn smooth, so my steps are silent.

lines.zh: 灵石上的刻痕，我每天摸一遍。
lines.en: Each day I run my hand over the carved wards.

lines.zh: 我数着地板，第三块是空的。
lines.en: I count the tiles; the third one is hollow.

lines.zh: 回廊尽头有风，说明有门开了。
lines.en: Wind at the corridor's end means a door is open.

lines.zh: 我把长矛靠在肩上，换个姿势。
lines.en: I rest the spear on my shoulder and shift my stance.

lines.zh: 宝库里没有声音，这很好。
lines.en: No sound comes from the vault; that is good.

lines.zh: 我检查锁孔里有没有灰。
lines.en: I check the keyhole for dust.

lines.zh: 今天没人来，我已经站了六个时辰。
lines.en: No one came today; I have stood six hours.

lines.zh: 我数着自己呼吸，一次一数。
lines.en: I count my own breaths, one number each.

lines.zh: 石英墙在夜里会冷得发白。
lines.en: The quartz walls go cold and pale at night.

lines.zh: 我记得每个来过这里的人的脸。
lines.en: I remember the face of everyone who came here.

lines.zh: 上面那层的钟，我听着就能报时。
lines.en: By the bell above, I can tell the hour.

lines.zh: 我把护腕的带子又紧了一格。
lines.en: I tighten the strap on my bracer one notch.

lines.zh: 影子从东边过来，是柱子挡住的光。
lines.en: A shadow comes from the east; it is only a pillar.

lines.zh: 停在那里，宝库不接待客人。
lines.en: Stop there; the vault receives no guests.

lines.zh: 你的手离墙远一点。
lines.en: Keep your hands away from the wall.

lines.zh: 我看了你三息，你没动，很好。
lines.en: I watched you three breaths and you did not move.

lines.zh: 这扇门后面，你没有资格看。
lines.en: You have no right to see behind this door.

lines.zh: 你走路的声音，是从外面来的。
lines.en: The sound of your walk comes from outside.

lines.zh: 我不问你是谁，只问你走不走。
lines.en: I do not ask who you are, only whether you leave.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛一直往锁上看。
lines.en: Your eyes keep drifting toward the lock.

lines.zh: 这里的地砖，你踩歪了一块。
lines.en: You have shifted one of the floor tiles.

lines.zh: 上面的人知道你来了吗？
lines.en: Do the ones above know you are here?

lines.zh: 抬起头，我要记住这张脸。
lines.en: Lift your head; I will remember this face.

lines.zh: 甲片凹了一块，不影响。
lines.en: One plate is dented; it does not matter.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，脚跟抵住门槛。
lines.en: I fall back half a step, heel against the threshold.

lines.zh: 这点伤，换岗前能撑住。
lines.en: This much I can carry until the shift ends.

lines.zh: 你打中了接缝，运气不错。
lines.en: You hit the seam; lucky for you.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊了会吓到里面。
lines.en: I do not shout; it would alarm those inside.

lines.zh: 血顺着手腕流进护腕里。
lines.en: Blood runs down my wrist into the bracer.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙把矛重新握正。
lines.en: I grit my teeth and reset my grip on the spear.

lines.zh: 门还在我背后，这就够了。
lines.en: The door is still behind me; that is enough.

lines.zh: 这一下，我会在报告里写清楚。
lines.en: This blow goes into my report, in full.

lines.zh: 你比上一个来的人有力气。
lines.en: You hit harder than the last one who came.

lines.zh: 别拿钥匙晃，那不管用。
lines.en: Do not dangle keys at me; that will not work.

lines.zh: 绿宝石我见过成堆的，收起来。
lines.en: I have seen emeralds by the heap; put it away.

lines.zh: 你若给我一把真钥匙，我或许听。
lines.en: Bring me a real key and I might listen.

lines.zh: 贿赂守卫，会写进名册里。
lines.en: Bribing a guard goes into the register.

lines.zh: 我伸手接了，只是要折断它。
lines.en: I take it only to snap it in half.

lines.zh: 那不是宝库里的东西，你哪来的？
lines.en: That is not from the vault; where did you get it?

lines.zh: 我看了很久，然后放回你手里。
lines.en: I look a long while, then put it back in your hand.

lines.zh: 有价的东西，在这里反而危险。
lines.en: Anything with a price is dangerous here.

lines.zh: 你举得太高了，像在喂牲口。
lines.en: You hold it too high, as if feeding livestock.

lines.zh: 我不缺这个，我缺一场好觉。
lines.en: I do not lack that; I lack a good sleep.

lines.zh: 退开，你踩到我的巡逻线了。
lines.en: Back off; you are standing on my patrol line.

lines.zh: 我的矛横过来了，你自己看着办。
lines.en: My spear turns sideways; decide what you will do.

lines.zh: 撞我可以，别撞门。
lines.en: Bump into me if you must, not the door.

lines.zh: 你的肩很硬，我记住了。
lines.en: Your shoulder is hard; I have noted it.

lines.zh: 这条道两人并行会碰到墙。
lines.en: Two abreast here will scrape the walls.

lines.zh: 别挤，我背后是锁。
lines.en: Do not press; there is a lock behind me.

lines.zh: 站稳，地砖下面是空的。
lines.en: Stand steady; the floor is hollow beneath.

lines.zh: 我用矛柄抵住你的胸口，退后。
lines.en: I set my spear's butt against your chest; back away.

lines.zh: 你把我的钥匙撞响了。
lines.en: You have set my keys ringing.

lines.zh: 一次碰撞，我记一次。
lines.en: One collision, one mark against you.

lines.zh: 我守夜，不守别的。
lines.en: I keep the night watch, nothing else.

lines.zh: 这里的规矩，守卫不许成家。
lines.en: The rule here forbids guards to take spouses.

lines.zh: 我有钥匙就够，不需要伴。
lines.en: My keys are company enough.

lines.zh: 换岗时我们只点个头。
lines.en: At shift change we only nod.

lines.zh: 我的位置在门边，一个人的宽度。
lines.en: My post is beside the door, one person wide.

lines.zh: 别跟我说这些，我在数时辰。
lines.en: Do not speak of it; I am counting the hours.

lines.zh: 同袍倒下，我替他站完那班。
lines.en: When a comrade falls, I finish his watch.

lines.zh: 圣所不许，我便不想。
lines.en: The Sanctum forbids it, so I do not want it.

lines.zh: 我把这些话都锁在门后了。
lines.en: I have locked such words behind that door.

lines.zh: 你要找人说心里话，去外面。
lines.en: If you want confessions, go outside.

lines.zh: 地上一根断箭，我踩住它。
lines.en: A broken arrow lies here; I pin it with my boot.

lines.zh: 这枚钥匙不是我们的，收好。
lines.en: This key is not ours; I keep it.

lines.zh: 我把碎石扫到墙根，别挡路。
lines.en: I sweep rubble to the wall so it blocks nothing.

lines.zh: 有人掉了火石，会有人回来找。
lines.en: Someone dropped a flint; they will come back for it.

lines.zh: 这块布角，和教众的袍子一样。
lines.en: This scrap matches the cultists' robes.

lines.zh: 我拾起锁扣，装回门上。
lines.en: I pick up the hasp and fit it back on the door.

lines.zh: 台阶上有血，我先擦掉再看。
lines.en: Blood on the steps; I wipe it before I look closer.

lines.zh: 一枚铜环，是旗杆上的。
lines.en: A copper ring, from the banner pole.

lines.zh: 我弯腰也握着矛。
lines.en: Even bending down, I keep hold of my spear.

lines.zh: 这些东西都要交到上面登记。
lines.en: All of this goes upstairs to be logged.

lines.zh: 我听见锁在响，不是你碰的。
lines.en: I hear the lock rattle, and you did not touch it.

lines.zh: 站住，你越过了第三块砖。
lines.en: Halt; you crossed the third tile.

lines.zh: 我的手已经放在矛上了。
lines.en: My hand is already on the spear.

lines.zh: 宝库的门，从来不从外面开。
lines.en: The vault door never opens from outside.

lines.zh: 你身上的沙，是石英平地的。
lines.en: The sand on you comes from the quartz flats.

lines.zh: 我吹了一声哨，回廊会传很远。
lines.en: I blow one whistle; it carries down the corridor.

lines.zh: 宫里养着你这样的人，我不意外。
lines.en: The palace breeds your kind; I am not surprised.

lines.zh: 我不喊，是因为我想先问清楚。
lines.en: I do not shout because I want answers first.

lines.zh: 你来之前，这里安静了三个月。
lines.en: Before you came, this place was quiet three months.

lines.zh: 退到光里面去，我要看清你。
lines.en: Step into the light; I want to see you clearly.

lines.zh: 你带着撬棍，那就不是迷路。
lines.en: You carry a crowbar; then you are not lost.

lines.zh: 我把矛尖压低，这是最后一次警告。
lines.en: I lower the spear tip; this is the last warning.

lines.zh: 这一层的门，只为我身后的东西锁。
lines.en: These doors are locked for what stands behind me.

lines.zh: 你走进来了，那就别想原路出去。
lines.en: You walked in, so do not plan to leave that way.

lines.zh: 你的灯在拐角晃，我知道你来了。
lines.en: Your lamp sways at the corner. I know you're here.

lines.zh: 我不急，我的位置不会动。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; my post does not move.

lines.zh: 你在数门，我数你的脚步。
lines.en: You count the doors; I count your steps.

lines.zh: 石英地会把你的声音送过来。
lines.en: The quartz floor carries your sounds to me.

lines.zh: 你绕了三圈，还是这条回廊。
lines.en: Three circles, and still this colonnade.

lines.zh: 我的矛够长，你的刀不够。
lines.en: My spear is long enough; your blade is not.

lines.zh: 别贴着墙，墙后面是空的。
lines.en: Do not hug the wall; it is hollow behind.

lines.zh: 我在等你踩上那块空砖。
lines.en: I am waiting for you to step on that hollow tile.

lines.zh: 你喘得厉害，这层楼很高。
lines.en: You are breathing hard; this tier is high.

lines.zh: 我退一步，是为了让你再进一步。
lines.en: I step back so you will step forward.

lines.zh: 门在我身后，钥匙在我腰上。
lines.en: The door is behind me, the key at my belt.

lines.zh: 你看错了方向，那边是死路。
lines.en: You are looking the wrong way; that is a dead end.

lines.zh: 我把盾抬到下巴，你打不进来。
lines.en: I raise the shield to my chin; you cannot get through.

lines.zh: 灯油快烧完了，我们得快些。
lines.en: The lamp oil is low; we should finish this.

lines.zh: 你别动，我脚下的砖会响。
lines.en: Hold still; the tile under my boot will sound.

lines.zh: 我把矛横过来，回廊就窄了一半。
lines.en: I set the spear crosswise. The hall narrows by half.

lines.zh: 你数错了楼层，这层是我的。
lines.en: You miscounted the floors. This one is mine.

lines.zh: 你的影子先到，你人还没到。
lines.en: Your shadow arrives before you do.

lines.zh: 我不动手，我只等你动手。
lines.en: I won't strike. I wait for you to.

lines.zh: 矛尖往前一送，你退了半步。
lines.en: The spear tip goes forward, and you take half a step back.

lines.zh: 我这一下打在护肩上，不是要害。
lines.en: That blow lands on your shoulder guard, not a vital spot.

lines.zh: 你的刀在墙上弹开了。
lines.en: Your blade glances off the wall.

lines.zh: 我教你什么叫守门。
lines.en: Let me show you what guarding a door means.

lines.zh: 用盾顶你，比用矛省力。
lines.en: Shoving with the shield costs less than the spear.

lines.zh: 我砸你的膝，你站不稳了。
lines.en: I strike your knee, and your stance breaks.

lines.zh: 石英地上滑，你自己小心。
lines.en: The quartz floor is slick; mind your own footing.

lines.zh: 这一记是替被撬开的锁。
lines.en: This one is for the lock you forced.

lines.zh: 你退到台阶边了，别再退。
lines.en: You are at the stair's edge; go no further.

lines.zh: 矛柄横扫，你的火把掉了。
lines.en: The spear's shaft sweeps; your torch falls.

lines.zh: 我不用追，你会自己撞上来。
lines.en: I do not need to chase; you will come to me.

lines.zh: 我压住你的手腕，刀就松了。
lines.en: I pin your wrist, and the blade loosens.

lines.zh: 门响了一声，我得回头。
lines.en: The door creaks; I must look back.

lines.zh: 你若现在跪下，我就不再打。
lines.en: Kneel now, and I will strike no more.

lines.zh: 矛尖挑开你的袖口，血慢慢渗。
lines.en: The spear tip opens your sleeve. Blood seeps out slowly.

lines.zh: 这一下打在锁上，锁歪了。
lines.en: That blow lands on the lock. The lock bends.

lines.zh: 我从门后走出来，矛先出来。
lines.en: I step from behind the door, spear first.

lines.zh: 换岗的人没来，我接着站。
lines.en: The relief never came; I keep standing.

lines.zh: 这扇门今天我守第四班。
lines.en: I hold this door for the fourth watch today.

lines.zh: 石英墙上的刻痕又暗了一些。
lines.en: The wards on the quartz wall have dimmed again.

lines.zh: 我把钥匙串解下来，重新系紧。
lines.en: I unclip the key ring and tie it tighter.

lines.zh: 有人从平地那边过来了。
lines.en: Someone is coming from the flats.

lines.zh: 灯还亮着，说明里面没出事。
lines.en: The lamp still burns, so nothing inside has gone wrong.

lines.zh: 我清了清嗓子，回廊太干。
lines.en: I clear my throat; the corridor is dry.

lines.zh: 我的位置在第三根柱子旁。
lines.en: My post is beside the third pillar.

lines.zh: 今天风大，门缝在叫。
lines.en: The wind is strong; the door gap moans.

lines.zh: 我把盾从背上取下来。
lines.en: I take the shield off my back.

lines.zh: 别站在门口，这里要过人。
lines.en: Do not stand in the doorway; people pass here.

lines.zh: 火在甲上烧不起来，只是烫。
lines.en: Fire will not catch on the plates, but it burns.

lines.zh: 我从台阶滚下去，矛还握着。
lines.en: I roll down the steps, still holding the spear.

lines.zh: 宝库下的水沟，比我记得的深。
lines.en: The drain under the vault is deeper than I remembered.

lines.zh: 门被炸开了，我得先站起来。
lines.en: The door is blown open; I must get up first.

lines.zh: 箭插进盾里，拔不出来。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my shield and will not pull free.

lines.zh: 有东西绕过我的甲，钻进骨头。
lines.en: Something slips past my armor and into the bone.

lines.zh: 我两班没吃东西，手有点抖。
lines.en: Two shifts without food; my hands are unsteady.

lines.zh: 雷落在塔尖，整面墙都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the spire, and the whole wall lights up.

lines.zh: 底下没有地砖，只有黑。
lines.en: There are no tiles below, only black.
